title: The Limo
cn: 第 11 集 · 加长轿车
novel:
For New Year's Eve, Ted hired a white [[limousine|limousine]] and made a [[schedule|schedule]] of five parties.

The [[chauffeur|chauffeur]] was a calm man named Ranjit who had seen every kind of foolish night. Barney opened the [[champagne|champagne]] and made a [[toast|toast]]. Somebody put on a terrible [[mixtape|mixtape]] and refused to change it.

Party one was empty. Party two had been cancelled. [[En route|en route]] to party three they hit a [[traffic jam|traffic jam]] so long that Ranjit took a [[detour|detour]] through streets full of [[honking|honk]] taxis. A drunk man leaned on their [[bumper|bumper]]; snow melted on the [[windscreen|windscreen]].

Inside, six people sat [[cramped|cramped]] together, standing up through the [[sunroof|sunroof]] to shout at the cold city.

At 11:58 they were still on the road. The [[countdown|countdown]] began somewhere far away. There were no [[fireworks|fireworks]] above them, only a red light and the smell of wet coats.

It should have been an [[anticlimax|anticlimax]]. But at [[midnight|midnight]], sitting by the [[curb|curb]] with people he loved, Ted made only one New Year's [[resolution|resolution]]: to stop [[wasting|waste]] time hunting for a better party than the one he was already in.

limousine.cn: 加长豪华轿车（简称 limo）
limousine.en: a very long expensive car with a driver

schedule.en: a plan of what you will do and when

chauffeur.en: a person whose job is to drive someone in a car

champagne.en: an expensive white wine with bubbles, drunk to celebrate

toast.en: when people lift their glasses and wish someone well

mixtape.en: a collection of songs someone chose and put together

en route.en: on the way to a place

traffic jam.en: a long line of cars that cannot move

detour.en: a longer road you take because the usual one is blocked

honk.en: to make a loud sound with a car horn

bumper.en: the bar at the front or back of a car that takes small hits

windscreen.en: the big glass window at the front of a car

cramped.en: with too little space to move

sunroof.en: a window in the roof of a car that opens

countdown.en: counting backwards to zero before something happens

fireworks.en: things that explode in the sky with colour and noise

anticlimax.en: a disappointing end after you expected something exciting

curb.en: the raised edge between the road and the pavement

resolution.en: a firm promise you make to yourself to do better

waste.en: to use time or money badly, for nothing
